activeImages.title: Jeremiah's Call
activeImages.alt: Young Jeremiah stands beside flowering almond branches near a steaming clay pot.
activeImages.review: Young brown-complexioned, slim Jeremiah with natural dark curls and a prominent nose; youthful face ages plausibly into the adult images. Almond branch/pot combine chapter 1 visions, without claiming a visible divine portrait. Visible fingers, thumb and wrist coherent.

activeImages.title: The Potter's House and the Broken Jar
activeImages.alt: Jeremiah watches a potter reshape wet clay in a shaded workshop.
activeImages.review: Jeremiah is the seated observer at right, not the headwrapped potter at left. Adult dark curls, beard, brown complexion and prominent nose fit the earlier call after aging. Wet-clay hands/grip, observer hands and covered body coherent. Jar-making illustrates chapter 18; broken fragments contextualize the broader 18–19 Story.

activeImages.title: Jeremiah and Pashhur
activeImages.alt: Jeremiah stands beside empty wooden stocks as Pashhur listens near a temple gate.
activeImages.review: Jeremiah at left retains natural curls, prominent nose, beard and lean build; Pashhur is the distinct official at right. Empty stocks fit release in 20:3. Open palms/fingers, thumbs, forearms and the official’s visible hands coherent; hidden legs not certified.

activeImages.title: Hananiah's False Prophecy
activeImages.alt: Hananiah holds a broken wooden yoke before Jeremiah and a listening crowd.
activeImages.review: Jeremiah at left retains the adult identity; Hananiah at right has his own face and holds the broken yoke (28:10). Visible grips, hands, forearms and listening crowd anatomy coherent at native resolution; obscured background features limited.

activeImages.title: The Scroll Burned
activeImages.alt: Baruch writes on a scroll as Jeremiah dictates beside a winter hearth.
activeImages.review: Graying Jeremiah dictates at right; younger Baruch at left has dense natural dark curls, dark beard, brown complexion and sturdy adult build. Pen grip, writing arm, resting hand and Jeremiah’s palms coherent. Illustrates dictation/replacement (36:4,32), not the king burning a scroll beside them; winter hearth is imagined context.

activeImages.title: Jeremiah in the Cistern
activeImages.alt: Ebed-melech and a helper lift Jeremiah with ropes cushioned by cloth beneath his armpits.
activeImages.review: Replace v1 wrist/cloth bindings with v2: visible cloth cushions beneath both armpits under lifting cords, wrists free (38:11–13). Actual v1 target plus approved dictation and flight files supplied identities; Genesis 7 style only. Full-size comparison retains Jeremiah, Ebed-melech and the headwrapped helper; visible anatomy/rope paths coherent. Cropped body and hidden grips limited. Broad 37–38 Story keeps 37:1 anchor.

activeImages.title: The Fall of Jerusalem and Flight to Egypt
activeImages.alt: Jeremiah walks with displaced families and loaded donkeys toward green lowlands.
activeImages.review: Older graying Jeremiah retains brown complexion, prominent nose, curls, full beard and lean build. Staff grip, visible hands/arms, child proportions and donkey heads/visible legs coherent. Anonymous families are not asserted to be identical earlier people. Story 39–43 illustrates later flight; imagined geography compresses distance and is not a route map.

activeImages.title: New Covenant
activeImages.alt: Jeremiah speaks to families beneath olive trees overlooking Jerusalem.
activeImages.review: Older brown-complexioned Jeremiah has graying natural curls/beard and prominent profile, compatible with late ministry. Imagined literary teaching vignette; 31:31–34 does not date an actual outdoor gathering. No exact age is assigned. Visible palms, listener hand, faces and child proportions coherent. Compiled Covenants catalog supplies an existing Jeremiah 31:31 heading; retain that placement and its cross-book anchors.
